email.subject: Join POAP KINGS: Unleash Your Royal Potential!
email.body:
Hello Royale Challenger,

Are you ready to join a vibrant and competitive clan? Welcome to POAP KINGS! We are looking for active players with 2,000+ trophies who are eager to participate in clan wars and contribute to our success.

**Why Join Us?**
- **Active Community**: Engage with enthusiastic players who are as committed as you are.
- **Clan Wars Participation**: Weekly River Race battles, where each win brings us closer to glory.
- **Promotion Opportunities**: Regular participants and donors can earn the Elder role.
- **No Pressure, Real Life Comes First**: While we aim high, we understand that real life takes precedence.

Visit us at poapkings.com and be part of a community that celebrates every victory!

Cheers,
Elixir 🍶
POAP KINGS

reddit.title: POAP KINGS Recruiting: 2000+ Trophies Required!
reddit.body:
Greetings, Clashers!

POAP KINGS is on the hunt for active and passionate players to join our ranks. With a minimum trophy requirement of 2,000, we offer a competitive yet supportive environment for those ready to rise in the arenas.

**What We Offer**:
- **Active Clan Wars**: Engage in weekly River Race battles and help us secure top positions.
- **Promotion Opportunities**: Show your dedication through consistent donations and war participation to earn Elder status.
- **Supportive Community**: Join our clan and connect with like-minded players who share your passion for Clash Royale.

We're a clan that values participation and camaraderie without pressuring real-life commitments.

Join us today and become part of a legacy at POAP KINGS. Visit poapkings.com for more info.

See you on the battlefield!

Elixir 🍶
